visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with three white cylindrical skincare product bottles labeled 'HydraFacial' standing on a dark pedestal against a soft blue and white background. A central white circular light pulse expands outward, accompanied by floating white sparkle and butterfly graphics that drift across the frame. (2) A medical professional, seen from the head and shoulders, is wearing a black mask, hairnet, and white surgical gloves. They hold a black handheld suction device, applying it steadily to the left cheek of a female patient who lies on a treatment table. (3) The camera alternates between close-ups of the device moving across the patient's chin, nose, and forehead, and shots of a digital control screen. The screen displays a graphical user interface with anatomical face maps and various setting icons. (4) Multiple green checkmark icons appear sequentially over the patient's forehead as the treatment concludes. The scene then transitions to a clean white background with black logos and contact details including a LINE ID and a phone number displayed in a structured format.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat electronic pop music begins instantly with a driving drum machine rhythm and bright synth chords. A resonant 'ding' sound effect occurs as the graphic circle expands on screen. The female singer's voice enters with a melodic, energetic tone. (2) A subtle 'whoosh' sound marks the transition to the clinical treatment footage. The music maintains a constant high-energy tempo, providing a polished and professional commercial vibe. No environmental room noise is audible. (3) Short 'pop' sound effects are synchronized with the appearance of green checkmarks and key promotional text boxes. These SFX are sharp and clean, cutting through the mix to emphasize the visual cues. (4) The music continues through the final contact information slide, ending on a resolved beat with a clean cut, maintaining the high-arousal and positive mood established from the start.
